title: PLI agent worksheet
description: The interpretive output the Cursor agent must produce for one action. Everything downstream is deterministic table lookup in engine.py.

submission_month.description: FO 2.0 month-of-submission anchor (YYYY-MM). Orchestrator-grounded on a fixed 6-month action cadence (session chronology from 2027-01); maps to calendar quarter for onset/ramp/decay. Agent should echo the provided month; live runs overwrite agent-invented values.

needs_human.description: True when the action cannot be classified cleanly under the codebook; the record is routed to the SME without scores.

instrument_of_power.description: Echo of Plenum actions.mechanism (Blue Instrument of Power).

diplomacy.description: True when Diplomacy Index track should run.

information.description: True when Information brief track should run.

secondary_facet_citation.description: Required when a secondary DIME facet is set contrary to primary Instrument of Power defaults.

instrument.description: Primary instrument code from the master codebook; null only for NE.

rule_citation.description: The codebook boundary or tie-break rule that decided the lever, quoted by number.

tier.description: Precedent tier from the trial codebook decision tree.

citations.description: Real statutes, standing authorities, or historical analogs supporting the tier (e.g., 'Section 301, Trade Act of 1974').

modifier_rationales.description: One-line justification for each modifier set to true.

rationale.description: Mechanism narrative tying the anchor band/score to the declared orientation (prefer 2–4 sentences, comparable to precedent.rationale).
